svg.title: Plait editable vector kit preview
svg.desc: Editable vector approximation manually reconstructed from the supplied Plait raster reference; not the original source artwork.
svg.text: Your projects. Every machine. Every thread.
Redrawn from the supplied raster reference. Scalable paths, editable gradients, no embedded bitmaps.
Approximation — the original vector geometry and exact typeface cannot be recovered from the raster image.
